title: Sunday · the ridge in fall
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The ridge in October from the mudflats, the alders yellow in the conifers, the glow above the treeline larger than April 2016 had it. The strip measures by drawing.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the forested ridge in October from the flats: the alders gone yellow among the dark conifers, and above the treeline the glow, warm, wider than before.

image.prompt: a forested ridge in October seen across mudflats with yellow alders among dark conifers and a warm glow above the treeline wider than a hand, no words
image.notes: Wider than dw_2016-04-10. The reader can compare.

panels.name: Ridge

panels.composition: Tier 2: the alders, close, the yellow, one leaf letting go.

panels.name: Alders

panels.composition: Tier 3: a tidal channel with the ridge's yellow and the glow's warmth both in it. Held.
